title: Exact pair density wave in topological moire flat bands and universal superfluid stiffness
authors: Zhengzhi Wu, Ming-rui Li, Hong Yao
abstract: Pair-density waves (PDWs) are unconventional superconducting states beyond the BCS paradigm, but identifying them unambiguously in microscopic lattice models is generally challenging due to various competing orders. In particular, an exact realization of PDW in interacting models with topological bands remains elusive. Here we construct an interacting model on a twisted bilayer checkerboard lattice (TBCB) featuring topological flat bands, and rigorously show that an exact PDW ground state can be induced by quantum geometric nesting (QGN), owing to its momentum-space nonsymmorphic symmetry. We further prove that the superfluid stiffness of any nondegenerate QGN superconductor (including the PDW studied here and uniform superconductor) obeys the universal relation $D_s=2N_{\rm flat}ν(1-ν)m_{\rm pair}^{-1}$, where $N_{\rm flat}$, $ν$, and $m_{\rm pair}$ are the number of flat bands, flat band filling, and the two-particle effective mass, respectively. Our results reveal a rich interplay among PDW order, quantum geometry, and band topology.
summary: This work establishes the existence of an exact Pair-Density Wave (PDW) ground state in a topological moiré flat band system using Quantum Geometric Nesting. Crucially, the authors derive a universal formula for the superfluid stiffness, linking it directly to the band topology and filling fraction. This provides a robust theoretical framework for understanding unconventional superconductivity in correlated electronic materials.
main_problem: The primary challenge is rigorously identifying and characterizing Pair-Density Wave (PDW) states, especially in interacting models built upon topological flat bands, and determining the associated superfluid stiffness.
method: The analysis combines constructing an exact ground state using symmetry constraints (QGN) with calculating the superfluid stiffness using both two-particle excitation spectra and mean-field/Fubini-Study metric approaches.
model_or_system: The system is a twisted bilayer checkerboard lattice (TBCB) featuring topological flat bands, modeled by a Hamiltonian $\hat{H} = \hat{H}_0 + \hat{V}$. The model is analyzed in the strong-coupling limit where the flat bands are effectively frozen.
key_observables: Superfluid stiffness ($D_s$), ground state energy scaling ($E''_{N}(0)$), and the topological lower bound for $D_s$.
